# awx_credential_object_roles (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awx_credential_object_roles" "container_registry" {
  id = awx_credential.container_registry.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Credential ID

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Map of Number) Roles for credential
